title: Ghost Line route.geojson
description: The 1938 route as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Each Feature is one leg, tagged with direction, street, method, note and length_m.

sources.description: Maps route blocks to source-ID arrays from the index.json catalog. features is covered by guide1938_route (the 1938 route description), osm (way geometry) and method (joining and clipping). Inferred geometry is explained by each leg's existing note. The emitter checks ID resolution and coverage of any additional numeric field.

features.description: One Feature per route leg, in route order.

SourceIds.description: Nonempty list of source IDs from the index.json catalog.

coordinates.description: Sequence of [longitude, latitude] positions along the leg.

Position.description: [longitude, latitude] in WGS-84 decimal degrees. A third element (elevation) is allowed by GeoJSON but not required.

direction.description: Line this leg belongs to. Westbound legs form one line; loop legs and eastbound legs form the other, so loop legs use 'eastbound'.

length_m.description: Leg length in metres (WGS84 geodesic). Covered by the 'features' source mapping.

street.description: Name of the street or segment this leg follows, e.g. 'North Avenue'.

method.description: How the leg geometry was obtained. 'osm' = joined directly from OSM ways; 'osm+gap' = joined with one or more declared bridged breaks; 'inferred' = geometry hand-entered because no OSM trace was available.

note.description: Explanatory note for the leg, required when method is 'inferred'; null otherwise.
